verdict.rationale: Cognee's own docs say the full memory engine can run locally or on your own stack, including via a first-party Docker container. That lets users keep data wherever they deploy it. However, nothing in the evidence shows region selection or data-residency guarantees for Cognee Cloud, and `cognee-cli push` uploads data to the Cloud with no stated location. missing for 10: Cognee Cloud region selection, documented data-residency commitments, configurable storage-location docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.
you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required
Run Cognee locally using Docker for development, testing, and custom deployments.
